applies_to: EKMBDXB7V1 Modbus RTU interface on the DIII-net of Daikin VRV, Sky Air, split (via KRP928), VAM/VKM ventilation, VRV hydrobox, air curtains, ERQ control box, heating and applied units; design guide 4P642495-1A (2022.02).
summary: The EKMBDXB connects to the Daikin DIII-net and presents up to 64 indoor groups (DIII addresses 1-00 to 4-15) to a BMS as Modbus RTU registers. Each group has capability, status, setpoint, room temperature, water setpoint, error and lock registers. This map lists the gateway status words and the full register set of group 1-00 plus the formula for the other groups.

addressing.note: The guide prints 30001/40001-style registers and says the request address starts at zero: 30001 is sent as 0 and 40001 as 0. Its example frames agree (31001 is requested as 0x03E8, 42002 as 0x07D1).

source.title: Design guide Modbus Interface DIII EKMBDXB7V1
source.pages: p. 10 settings, pp. 11-13 frames and addressing, p. 21 register overview and group formula, pp. 21-31 input registers, pp. 32-39 holding registers

notes: Only DIII group 1-00 is listed. Register of another group = base register + ((upper address - 1) x 16 + lower address) x step. Steps: 31001/42001 blocks step 3, 31401/32801/42401 step 4, 32001 step 6, 33601 step 2, 42801 step 1. Example: 4-15 capability = 31190.

Status 1 (32001): bits 12-14 fan speed 0-7 (meaning depends on the fan-speed step capability; 3-step: 0 auto, 1 L, 3 M, 5 H), bits 8-10 fan direction (0-4 P0-P4, 6 stop, 7 swing). Status 2 (32002): bits 0-3 operation mode (0 fan, 1 heat, 2 cool, 3 auto, 4 ventilation, 7 dry), bits 4-7 filter sign (0 off, 1-15 on), bits 8-11 actual operation (0 fan, 1 heat, 2 cool), bits 14-15 cool/heat master (0 undecided, 1 slave, 2 master).

Control 1 (42001): bit 0 on/off, bits 4-7 fan control flag (6 = fan control, 0 = none), bits 8-10 fan direction, bits 12-14 fan speed. Control 2 (42002): bits 0-3 mode (0 fan, 1 heat, 2 cool, 3 auto, 4 ventilation, 6 setpoint/dependent, 7 dry), bits 4-7 filter sign reset (15 = reset, then write 0 again).

Setpoint range fields are signed 8-bit values in 1 °C packed into a 16-bit word; they are listed as UINT16 because the schema has no 8-bit type. The storage (hot water) setpoint byte in 32803/42403 is described both as 'unity 1 °C' and as 'value multiplied by 10', so its scale is not given here.

Error code 33601: high byte and low byte are the two ASCII characters of the Daikin code (e.g. 'C7'); '00' means no error. 33602 holds unit number (bits 12-15), warning/alarm/error flags (bits 10/9/8) and sub-code (bits 0-5).
Room setpoint, water setpoints and temperatures are signed 16-bit in 0.1 °C. Out-of-range setpoints are clamped by the unit; read the input register for the result.

registers.name: DIII units 2-00..2-15 communication
registers.description: 1 = communication error.

registers.name: DIII units 3-00..3-15 communication
registers.description: 1 = communication error.

registers.name: DIII units 4-00..4-15 communication
registers.description: 1 = communication error.

registers.name: 1-00 capability
registers.description: Bits 8-10 fan direction steps, bits 12-14 fan speed steps (0-7).

registers.name: 1-00 cooling setpoint range
registers.description: High byte lower limit, low byte upper limit; each signed 8-bit, 1 °C.

registers.name: 1-00 heating setpoint range
registers.description: High byte lower limit, low byte upper limit; each signed 8-bit, 1 °C.

registers.name: 1-00 water capability
registers.description: Leaving water, low noise, space heating and reheat capability flags.

registers.name: 1-00 cooling water setpoint range
registers.description: High byte upper limit, low byte lower limit; each signed 8-bit, 1 °C.

registers.name: 1-00 heating water setpoint range
registers.description: High byte upper limit, low byte lower limit; each signed 8-bit, 1 °C.

registers.name: 1-00 status 1
registers.description: Bits 12-14 fan speed, bits 8-10 fan direction (0-4 P0-P4, 6 stop, 7 swing).

bits.2: Forced off (T1-T2 input or central forced off)
bits.3: Normal operation (1 = running normally; 0 = off, or on with an error)

registers.name: 1-00 status 2
registers.description: Bits 0-3 mode, 4-7 filter sign, 8-11 actual run, 14-15 cool/heat master (see notes).

registers.name: 1-00 room temperature
registers.description: Suction temperature, or user-interface sensor if set up.

registers.name: 1-00 hot water / quiet status
registers.description: High byte: storage setpoint (signed 8-bit; scale stated inconsistently, see notes).

registers.name: 1-00 ventilation mode
registers.description: Bits 6-7: 1 auto, 2 energy reclaim, 3 bypass (VAM only).

registers.name: 1-00 error code
registers.description: Two ASCII characters, high byte first; "00" = no error.

registers.name: 1-00 error detail
registers.description: Bits 12-15 unit number, bits 0-5 sub-code.

registers.name: Central forced off
registers.description: 1 = force off all DIII units (only without other DIII devices).

registers.name: 1-00 control 1
registers.description: Bit 0 on/off, bits 4-7 = 6 for fan control, fan direction, fan speed.

registers.name: 1-00 control 2
registers.description: Bits 0-3 operation mode, bits 4-7 filter sign reset (15).

registers.name: 1-00 hot water / quiet command
registers.description: High byte storage setpoint (signed 8-bit, scale unclear); bit 2 quiet, bit 0 reheat.

registers.name: 1-00 ventilation mode command
registers.description: Bits 6-7: 1 auto, 2 energy reclaim, 3 bypass (VAM only).

registers.name: 1-00 user interface lock
registers.description: 1 = button disabled on the remote controller.

integration.summary: Wait for 30001 bit 0 = ready, read 30002-30005 to find connected groups, then poll each group's 32001-32005 status block. To command, copy the current status bits into 42001/42002 first, change only what you need, and write setpoints to 42003 in 0.1 °C.
integration.enable: Set baud rate, parity/stop bits and the Modbus address (1-15) on dip switches DS1/DS2 of the interface; the DIII units are discovered automatically after power-up.
quirks: Holding registers only take the unit's values at discovery; the BMS must copy the related input-register bits into a holding register before changing one field, or it will overwrite the others.
Write the fan control flag (42001 bits 4-7) as 6 when commanding fan speed or direction, 0 if the unit has no fan control.
Do not write the same register more often than every 0.5 s. Each indoor unit accepts at most 7000 control commands per year.
setup: Modbus address 1-15 on DS2; baud 9600 or 19200 and Even/Odd/None parity on DS1.
Set termination with the SS switches at the end of the RS485 line.
gotchas: Central forced off (41001) and the button locks (42801+) only work when no other DIII central controller (e.g. iTM) is on the same DIII-net.
After a power cut of the interface, forced off and locks must be written again once the units are rediscovered.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
